summary: Materialized and read the full Klein–Turri coauthored IEP article, repeated live bytes/text match. The source explicitly treats noncircularity/endlessness as necessary not jointly sufficient, distinguishes available reasons from actual infinite production and not-yet-reason-enhanced premises from wholly unjustified premises, restricts the enhancement/interrogation status and preserves proof-of-concept/opposed-chain/origin objections. Existing RegressSchema, Graph.grounded_eq_lfp and accessibilityAllowsUnboundedDepth already certify the structural controls; rejected duplicating a successor model or the arbitrary-finite-depth-versus-one-endless-chain control. No new theorem, contradiction of infinitism or causal/temporal transfer is claimed. Remaining blocker for an adequacy conclusion: independently defend the reasonhood/availability and transfer-or-generation norm, plus its actual applicability. Root premise delta none. A bounded 2024 Wayback fallback check produced a different selected text hash; it was not adopted as an equivalent witness.
